title: Challenge 3: Prepare the |−⟩ State
storyScenario: An oracle query requires preparing the target ancillary qubit in the minus state to activate the Phase Kickback mechanism.
description: Transform ground state |0⟩ into anti-phase superposition state: |−⟩ = (|0⟩ − |1⟩)/√2.

starterCode.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def build_circuit():
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    qc.x(0)
    qc.h(0)
    return qc
starterCode.cirq:
import cirq
q = cirq.LineQubit(0)
circuit = cirq.Circuit(cirq.X(q), cirq.H(q))

editorial.algorithmicAnalysis: The state |−⟩ is an eigenstate of the Pauli-X operator with eigenvalue -1, making it the canonical phase kickback target.

hints: Try applying an X gate first to reach |1⟩, then an H gate.
Alternatively, apply H followed by Pauli-Z.
